posts.author: bulmabriefs144
posts.body:
My name has been taken in vain, so I have appeared (four years too late).
The game is designed to work for old-school RpgMaker 2003,
not
the proprietrary RpgMaker 2k3 for Steam. I did it this way because I was using DynRpg.
This is the runtime package that I used. It has alot of excess stuff for people who want their game custom-modded with DynRpg, but the main game should work just by setting up the old RTP (it's called rm2k3-install.exe) and if needed importing anything (you shouldn't need to as I think RTP files tend to auto-run once installed, but if you do, drag it over, and then if it asks, "Let Me Decide for Each One" and pick the stuff). Ignore the Prepatched unless it's still not working. In which case, drag the Prepatched stuff to Oracle of Tao to get things running.
Rpgmaker.zip | Powered by Box
app.box.com
This game is also in a French RPG Maker website, and itch.io website.
You won't see David on the main stuff. It was used as the engine in order to do certain things (mainly higher than normal damage). I had a lot of unnecessary directions for customization (you could change the color of text to alot of different options). People complained that the text was unreadable alot, so I went and made several different texts before finding out the one thing you really do need to do. Go to the Fonts folder. Open it. Click on each file, and install it. If that doesn't work, try using the FontChanger (I think it's in Extras).
Latest copy of Oracle of Tao here:
Oracle of Tao by bulmabriefs144
A girl with a ying-yang tattoo saves the world from demons and angels... and stuff
bulmabriefs144.itch.io
This stuff is in the Extras folder. Most of it you don't need unless you want it.
It's not very EasyRpg compatible (this will skip the title sequence). But the overall game should work with the correct RTP.
Sorry you didn't find it each to use. It's a very customized game engine, so you have to use an older version of RpgMaker.
